verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and pricing layer, so multi-currency charging and FX settlement is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions local-currency pricing, currency conversion, settlement currency or FX transparency. Its reliance on Stripe is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling
